cues.text:
When seasons turn and plans give way
When hope is hard to find today

We bring our fears before Your throne
Our faithful God, we are not alone

You are our refuge and our strength
Your mercy meets us day by day

The world around us will not last
But all Your promises stand fast

When all around us starts to change
Jesus, Your love remains the same

Our faithful Lord, our strength always
Through every season, still You stay

Yesterday, now and evermore
You are the One we trust, O Lord

Our hearts will rest upon Your name
Jesus, forever You're the same

When grief is near and answers wait
When roads are long and burdens great

You do not turn Your face away
Your mercies meet each dawning day

The earth may shake beneath our feet
Still You are here in all we meet

Your word endures when flowers fade
We trust the promise You have made

When all around us starts to change
Jesus, Your love remains the same

Our faithful Lord, our strength always
Through every season, still You stay

Yesterday, now and evermore
You are the One we trust, O Lord

Our hearts will rest upon Your name
Jesus, forever You're the same
You have been faithful through the years
You will be faithful through our tears

Our refuge when the storms arise
Our hope in life, our risen Christ

When all around us starts to change
Jesus, Your love remains the same

Our faithful Lord, our strength always
Through every season, still You stay

Yesterday, now and evermore
You are the One we trust, O Lord

Our hearts will rest upon Your name
Jesus, forever You're the same
Through every season, still You stay
Jesus, forever You're the same
